blocks.text: You can configure device control policies for various resources that you add to the Resources page for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
Resources provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Add resources for removable storage, portable devices, and printers.

blocks.text: On the Resources page (Analytics > Endpoint Data Scan > Resources), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select a resource (i.e., Removable Storage, Portable Devices, or Printers).
View the list of device control rules on the respective page. You can view the following details:
Vendor ID: The vendor ID for the resource. Applicable for removable storage and portable devices only.
Product ID: The product ID for the resource. Applicable for removable storage and portable devices only.
Serial Number: The serial number assigned to the resource. Applicable for removable storage and portable devices only.
IP Address: The IP address of the printer resource. Applicable to printers only.
UNC: The UNC path for the printer resource. Applicable to printers only.
Description: A note or description of the resource.
Rearrange the columns and search for column names on the page.
To add, edit, or delete a resource, see Managing a Removable Storage Resource, Managing a Portable Device Resource, and Managing a Printer Resource.
